runs.title: City hall: 30 agents fix 8 departments (passed)
runs.description: Thirty worker agents and a lead on a local Claude CLI fix 32 modules across 8 city departments. Two stale developer tests change under human-accepted contracts; acceptance climbs 106, 109, 208, 234, then 237 of 237 at revision 8, which is gated and promoted. All 34 items completed.

runs.title: Storefront: correct and safe (passed)
runs.description: Six agents on a local Claude CLI make the storefront correct and safe: a stale developer test is changed under a human-accepted contract, acceptance climbs 79, 103, 126, 128, then 129 of 129 at revision 6, which is gated and promoted.

runs.title: service-api: 6 items, gate passed on revision 4, verified and promoted
runs.description: A lead and 3 workers fix a multi-resource API (input validation and auth on every resource) under a one-item claim cap. Failing revisions blame only items whose own tests fail; agents whose work waits on others take the next item. Acceptance climbs 10/20 -> 14/20 -> 18/20 -> 20/20 on revision 4, a speculative round lands one more push on revision 5, and the gated commit is promoted. Recorded verdict: verified.

runs.title: service-api: 6 items, gate passed on revision 3, verified
runs.description: A lead and 3 workers fix a multi-resource API (input validation and auth on every resource). They claim 6 resource items, a codemod tool is built, gated, and published, and the integrated tree goes from acceptance 10/20 (revision 1) to 16/20 (revision 2) to 20/20: revision 3 passes the app's own gate. Recorded verdict: verified.

runs.title: storefront: failed honestly, best acceptance 40/129
runs.description: A lead and 6 workers on a multi-domain storefront (exact money, payment limits, auth, input validation). They publish a scanner and a codemod, negotiate 3 contract changes (one decided by a human), ask for help, and hand items off, but a shared Invoice contract change breaks typecheck for revisions 2 to 9; revision 10 reaches acceptance 40/129. No revision passed the gate, so nothing was promoted. Recorded verdict: failed.

runs.title: storefront: failed honestly, stalled at 35/129
runs.description: The same storefront goal with a lead and 6 workers: 7 contract proposals (6 accepted, 1 rejected by the lead, 4 escalated to a human), help requests, a volunteer, and handoffs. Acceptance peaks at 35/129 on revisions 6 and 7, later revisions fail typecheck, and two seam items stall. No revision passed the gate, so nothing was promoted. Recorded verdict: failed.

runs.title: SIMULATED: 100 scripted agents on a 100-module project
runs.description: Simulated: the real board engine (offline) with scripted agents (no model chose anything) and the offline fixture gate, not the project's tests. A generated project of 10 domains x 10 route modules over shared contracts; the real board engine runs the claims, tools, integration, fix loop, and promotion while every agent turn is scripted. 101 agent(s), 101 item(s) proposed, 2 integrated revision(s); last revision 2: gate pass; 853 board messages.
